Priya: Opening a small docs PR to add a preflight checklist for on‑prem/private installs: networking (nftables + iptables examples), PKCS#11 tips, installer flags migration, and airgap bundle best practices. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3399

Tom: Nice. Can you include a short nftables example and a note about kernel conntrack table sizes? We saw installs fail under heavy simultaneous connections.

Priya: Added nftables snippet and conntrack note. Snippet: ```nft
table inet redwood_preflight {
  chain output { type filter hook output priority 0;
    ip daddr {198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.5} accept # metrics
    tcp dport 443 ct state established,related accept
    counter reject with icmpx admin-prohibited
  }
}
```
Also added conntrack sysctl example: `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`

Anya: Please add SELinux note + stat permission check for PKCS#11 libs and mention systemd drop-in to source /etc/redwood/installer.env.

Priya: Done. PKCS#11 quick checks: `stat -c '%a %U:%G %n' /opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so` and SELinux fix: `sudo chcon -t textrel_shlib_t /opt/hsm/libpkcs11.so`. Drop-in example: `[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/etc/redwood/installer.env`

Tom: One more: highlight installer flag rename in v0.9.4 (`--allow-private-endpoints` -> `--enable-private-dns`) and add a 1-line migration tip to set the env var for upgrades.

Priya: Added migration tip + a short blurb recommending mounting vendor libs from internal package mirrors instead of bundling in the airgap tar (browser upload size limits).

ci-bot: Preview site: https://deploy-preview.redwood.io/3399 — link check found docs/kms/old-proxy -> replaced with docs/kms/proxy-config.

Anya: Quick smoke run tomorrow on lab infra to validate pkcs11 load with PrivateTmp=false and verify installer honors ENV file. If green, we can merge.

Tom: LGTM after smoke test. Small but useful addition for support.

Priya: Thanks — merging after QA pass.
